# Keyblade Masters Ultrawide - Kingdom Hearts III

Version 1.0.1 (original release 5 Jun 2026) by m.vico. Licensed under CC BY-NC-ND 4.0; see [LICENSE](./LICENSE).

Adds ultrawide support, removes pillarboxing, and expands the field of view and level of detail for wider aspect ratios. The author reports testing at 16:10, 21:9, 32:9, and 48:9.

This repository includes the supplied v1.0.1 archive; the [Nexus Mods page](https://www.nexusmods.com/kingdomhearts3/mods/2553) currently lists v1.0.2.

## Installation

Extract the release archive into `KINGDOM HEARTS III\Binaries\Win64`, alongside `KINGDOM HEARTS III.exe`.

For SteamOS / Wine, set this Steam launch option:

`WINEDLLOVERRIDES="d3d11=n,b" %command%`

## Configuration

Edit `KH3-UW-config.ini`. The width and height default to `auto`; set both values to choose a specific resolution. The `[FOV]` options allow a custom third-person field of view and an adjustment to other camera views.
